title: 第18章 章 福民被抓第19章 吃醋
content_zh:
第一卷 重生归来 第十八章 章福民被抓
苏芮恶劣的看着陶泽西脸上的表情变来变去，从惊喜，变为怀疑，再从怀疑变为沮丧。真是精彩极了。
当听到苏胤有可能也喜欢自己的时候，陶泽西觉得这一个惊喜就要把自己淹没了，但是很快他就高兴不起来了，因为他突然想到苏胤曾经有过女朋友啊。再一想到自己这么多年来无果的暗恋，他整个人都不好了。
虽然苏芮看着陶泽西脸上的表情变来变去的很好玩，但是她也不能玩的太过不是，毕竟这个将来很可能就是自己的大嫂啊。
“咳咳，桃子哥啊，你放心吧，我一定会帮你的。让你们终成眷属的。不过你父亲知道你喜欢男人嘛，将来会同意你和我大…那家伙在一起嘛？”
陶泽西泄气的坐在床上。
“我怎么敢让我爸知道！现在我还年轻，我爸妈还没催我结婚，不过将来就不一定了。”
“难道你就不想让他知道嘛？你能忍受你爱的人娶别人？如果你父母催你结婚，你是不是就随便找个人结了？”苏芮恨铁不成钢的质问道。
“难道你就不会后悔嘛？！如果我是你我就去表白！让他知道我的心意！我喜欢的人我一定会努力争取到！我是不会让他娶别人的，是我的东西旁人休想染指。反正我是做不来只要你幸福我就快乐那种人，而且我才不要独自躲在角落舔舐伤口。所以我劝你趁着现在还不晚就赶快告诉他你的心意吧，否则将来后悔了就什么都晚了。”
看着陶泽西依旧颓废的坐在床上，耷拉着头，一副全世界都抛弃我的样子。苏芮很不淑女的翻了个白眼。心中怀疑这真的是上一世那个鲜衣怒马卓尔不群的陶少嘛，这个受伤的小兽一样的家伙不会是别人假扮的吧。有这个可能，可是如果陶泽西不主动点，以自家大哥的性格，让他先说爱简直难如上青天啊。
就在苏芮想要开口再说些什么的时候，陶泽西突然抬起头，眼神坚定而且光彩夺目。好像做了什么重要的决定似的。
陶泽西看到张大嘴巴愣住的苏芮，不由的觉得尴尬。
“咳，谢谢你，我想我知道我想要的是什么了。”
苏芮看陶泽西这个样子，知道他是想明白了，终于松了一口气。她能做的只是帮忙搞定爷爷大伯他们而已，而他们两个人之间的事情最好还是由他们自己解决。
“最好是这样，我得回家了，你快点收集章福民的犯罪证据，千万不要误了那个人的生日哟。祝你好运。”苏芮冲他眨眨眼睛，就起身离开了。
苏芮走了之后，陶泽西坐了一会，就给他的父亲打了一个电话，电话内容不得而知，不过一个礼拜之后，章福民在办公室被人带走，同时带走的还有二把手李万民，三把手叶尔多思&8226；库尔班江等五人。
几天之后，章福民被判处无期徒刑，剥夺政治权利终身，没收所有个人财产。李万民被判处有期徒刑二十年，缓刑两年。其他章系人员也纷纷被抓，得到了应有的惩罚。
而章泽一在章福民被抓的第二天也被派出所逮捕归案，因为酒后驾车，闹市连环撞人案还没有彻底完结，再加上从李万生那里得到的一些证据，章泽一被判处死刑，缓期两年执行，剥夺政治权利终身。
短短两个礼拜，青木县作威作福十多年的土皇帝章福民被抓。为害一方的章泽一也得到了应有的惩罚。青木县经过一次大清洗，虽然弄得当官的人人自危，但对于老百姓来说，却是大快人心的好事。整个青木县，又焕发出浓浓的生机。
这一天是章泽一宣判的日子，但是苏芮却没有到场，因为她要接她的爸爸妈妈回家了。

青木县唯一的一座火葬场内，苏芮安静的看着父母被火蛇吞噬。
爸爸，妈妈，很快我就能带你们回家了，我会带你们回京城，去和爷爷奶奶们团聚。再见了，爸爸妈妈。
苏芮抱着父母的骨灰回到了四合院，杜言看着苏芮的背影欲言又止。最后只能化为无奈的叹息。
柳青云知道今天苏芮去做了什么，所以他很体贴的没有询问。他以为苏芮今天不会再出房门，可是临近晚饭时间，却闻到了饭菜的香味。走到厨房，果不其然看到苏芮一个人在做晚饭，与旁日没有一点不同。
柳青云在心中感慨万分，对苏芮更加怜惜。
吃饭的时候，苏芮突然开口说道“师傅，我们去京城吧。”
“哦？为何要去京城？在这青木县不好嘛？你可是答应过为师，章福民的事了结之后就随为师认真学习的。”
“我要去京城找我的亲人。他们都在那里。”苏芮平淡的的说。
柳青云看苏芮很坚持，就答应了，毕竟在哪学习不是学习呢，而且他离开京城很多年了，也很想念那里。所以这师徒俩决定一个礼拜之后就离开青木县，去京城寻亲。
自从苏芮重生那天跑出去救她父母，她就没有再回学校，这次决定去京城，所以让杜言去帮她办了转学手续，而她依旧没有露面。而她那个班主任王老师，因为在讲话的时候被苏芮打断，而且苏芮还没经过她的允许就私自跑出去，她认为这就是在挑战她的权威，所以她就想着等苏芮回学校一定要给她好看，不过她左等右等，苏芮也没回去上课。当一个老师来通知她，苏芮办转学手续的时候，她整张脸阴晴不定。想到苏芮的所作所为，不由的在心里暗骂。怪不得苏芮敢打断自己的讲话还敢私自跑出去呢，原来是早就打算好了要转学啊。
班主任的纠结苏芮是不知道的，就算她知道了也只会无视之。
陶泽西也在一切尘埃落定的时候就离开了青木县，他带着自己亲手粘的子弹壳坦克模型和苏芮的礼物，坐上了去往京城的飞机。
－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－
我去，更得有点晚了，对不起各位，我要去睡啦，明天要早起，晚安~
改了一下陶泽西去京城的时间。
content_en:
Volume 1 Rebirth and Return Chapter 18 Zhang Fumin was arrested
Su Rui watched in disgust as the expression on Tao Zexi's face changed, from surprise to suspicion, and then from suspicion to frustration. It's really wonderful.
When he heard that Su Yin might also like him, Tao Zexi felt that this surprise would overwhelm him, but soon he couldn't be happy anymore because he suddenly thought that Su Yin had a girlfriend. When he thought about his fruitless secret love for so many years, he felt bad.
Although it was fun for Su Rui to watch the expressions on Tao Zexi's face changing, she couldn't play too much. After all, this person would probably be her sister-in-law in the future.
"Ahem, Brother Taozi, don't worry, I will definitely help you. Let you get married eventually. But your father knows that you like men, will he allow you to be with my older... guy in the future?"
Tao Zexi sat on the bed frustrated.
"How dare I let my dad know! I'm still young now, and my parents haven't pushed me to get married yet, but that won't be the case in the future."
"Don't you want him to know? Can you tolerate the person you love marrying someone else? If your parents urge you to get married, will you just find someone to marry?" Su Ruihen asked indifferently.
"Don't you regret it?! If I were you, I would confess my feelings! Let him know my feelings! I will definitely work hard to get the person I like! I will not let him marry anyone else, and no one else can get involved in what is mine. Anyway, I can't be the kind of person who is happy as long as you are happy, and I don't want to hide in the corner alone and lick my wounds. So I advise you to tell him your feelings before it's too late, otherwise it will be too late if you regret it in the future."
I looked at Tao Zexi still sitting on the bed dejectedly, with his head hanging down, as if the whole world had abandoned me. Su Rui rolled her eyes unladylikely. I doubt in my heart that this is really the outstanding young Tao who wore bright clothes and angry horses in the previous life. This injured beast-like guy cannot be someone else pretending to be him. It was possible, but if Tao Zexi didn't take the initiative, given his eldest brother's character, it would be impossible for him to express love first.
Just when Su Rui was about to say something else, Tao Zexi suddenly raised his head, his eyes firm and dazzling. It seemed as if some important decision had been made.
Tao Zexi couldn't help but feel embarrassed when he saw Su Rui with her mouth wide open and stunned.
"Well, thank you, I think I know what I want."
Seeing Tao Zexi like this, Su Rui knew that he had figured it out and finally breathed a sigh of relief. All she could do was help deal with her grandfather and uncle, and it was best for them to resolve matters between them themselves.
"It's best this way. I have to go home. Hurry up and collect Zhang Fumin's criminal evidence. Don't miss that person's birthday. I wish you good luck." Su Rui winked at him, got up and left.
After Su Rui left, Tao Zexi sat for a while and then made a phone call to his father. The content of the call is unknown, but a week later, Zhang Fumin was taken away from the office, along with the second-in-command Li Wanmin, the third-in-command Yerdosi Kurbanjiang and five others.
A few days later, Zhang Fumin was sentenced to life imprisonment, deprived of political rights for life, and confiscated all personal property. Li Wanmin was sentenced to 20 years in prison, suspended for two years. Other members of the Chapter Department were also arrested one after another and received the punishment they deserved.
Zhang Zeyi was also arrested and brought to justice by the police station the day after Zhang Fumin was arrested. Because of drunk driving, the case of a series of collisions in the downtown area has not yet been completely concluded. Coupled with some evidence obtained from Li Wansheng, Zhang Zeyi was sentenced to death with a two-year suspended execution and deprived of political rights for life.
In just two weeks, Zhang Fumin, the local emperor in Qingmu County who had been domineering for more than ten years, was arrested. The harming partyZhang Zeyi also received the punishment he deserved. Qingmu County has gone through a major purge. Although everyone who is an official is in danger, it is a good thing for the people. The entire Aoki County is glowing with vitality again.
This day was the day when Zhang Zeyi was sentenced, but Su Rui was not present because she had to take her parents home.
In the only crematorium in Qingmu County, Su Rui watched quietly as her parents were swallowed by fire snakes.
Dad, Mom, I will be able to take you home soon. I will take you back to the capital to reunite with your grandparents. Goodbye, Mom and Dad.
Su Rui returned to the courtyard holding her parents' ashes. Du Yan looked at Su Rui's back and hesitated to speak. In the end it could only turn into a helpless sigh.
Liu Qingyun knew what Su Rui had done today, so he was considerate and didn't ask. He thought Su Rui would not leave the room again today, but as dinner time approached, he smelled the aroma of food. When I walked to the kitchen, I saw Su Rui cooking dinner alone, no different from the previous day.
Liu Qingyun was filled with emotion in her heart and felt even more pity for Su Rui.
While eating, Su Rui suddenly said, "Master, let's go to the capital."
"Oh? Why are you going to the capital? Isn't it good to be in Qingmu County? You promised to be a teacher, and you will study hard with me after Zhang Fumin's matter is settled."
"I'm going to the capital to find my relatives. They are all there." Su Rui said calmly.
Seeing Su Rui's persistence, Liu Qingyun agreed. After all, studying there is not studying, and he had been away from the capital for many years and missed it very much. So the master and apprentice decided to leave Aoki County in a week and go to the capital to find relatives.
Since Su Rui ran out to save her parents the day she was reborn, she has not returned to school. This time she decided to go to the capital, so she asked Du Yan to help her go through the transfer procedures, but she still did not show up. And her class teacher, Teacher Wang, was interrupted by Su Rui when she was speaking, and Su Rui ran out without her permission. She thought this was challenging her authority, so she thought that she would look good to Su Rui when she returned to school, but she waited and Su Rui didn't go back to class. When a teacher came to inform her that Su Rui was going through the transfer procedures, her whole face was filled with uncertainty. Thinking of what Su Rui did, she couldn't help but curse in her heart. No wonder Su Rui dared to interrupt her speech and run out privately. It turned out that she had already planned to transfer to another school.
Su Rui didn't know about the head teacher's struggles. Even if she knew, she would just ignore it.
Tao Zexi also left Aoki County when everything was settled. He took the bullet tank tank model he glued with his own hands and Su Rui's gift and got on the plane to the capital.
－－－－－－Digression－－－－－
I'm going, it's a bit late. Sorry everyone, I'm going to bed. I have to get up early tomorrow. Good night~
The time for Tao Zexi to go to the capital was changed.
